messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Calculate multiple models at the same time
parts:
You could estimate models in parallel using the parallel package or some equivalent. 

makeCluster()
res <- parLapply(c('graded', 'gpcm'), function(type) mirt(data, itemtype = type))

HTH.

Phil
